confidence_notes: Food and drink estimates use recent Tampa price aggregates near the July 2026 window. Cocktail is about twice the local draft beer price; wine by the glass is estimated at about 1.5 times beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates and are less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used; food and drink estimates are Tampa-specific, while accommodation estimates reflect general knowledge of a U.S. Gulf Coast city.
